title: External ticket legacy auth counters live in metrics.py and are incremented in _authenticate_team
answers: Where is the legacy secret_api_token usage on the external ticket route measured?
How do I find which team still uses the legacy external ticket API token?
Removing the external ticket route (#63111): what metrics need deleting?
body:
Two Prometheus counters track legacy `secret_api_token` auth on the external ticket route, both incremented in `_authenticate_team` in products/conversations/backend/api/external.py:
- `TICKET_ACTION_AUTH_COUNTER` (`posthog_conversations_ticket_action_auth_total`, labels auth_method/http_method)
- `LEGACY_TICKET_AUTH_BY_TEAM_COUNTER` (`posthog_conversations_external_ticket_legacy_team_total`, label team_id)
Both are defined in products/conversations/backend/metrics.py. The per-team counter is explicitly temporary (#63111): delete it together with the route, along with its import in external.py.
Tests in products/conversations/backend/api/tests/test_external.py (`test_authenticated_requests_increment_the_legacy_auth_counters`) assert both from a single authenticated GET; the reviewer asked to extend the existing counter test rather than add a separate one. Update it if either counter changes.
applies: Conversations external ticket route auth metrics; relevant when adding metrics there or removing the legacy route.

The per-team counter is explicitly temporary (issue #63111) and must be deleted together with the route and its import; do not leave it orphaned. The test test_authenticated_requests_increment_the_legacy_auth_counters in products/conversations/backend/api/tests/test_external.py validates both from a single authenticated GET and must be updated if either counter changes. Applies to adding metrics on the external ticket route or removing the legacy authentication mechanism.
